# Results

The SMD pool included k = 8 effects. The pooled standardised mean difference
was -0.4327, which indicates a reduction in depressive symptoms favouring
exercise. Heterogeneity was considerable, with I-squared of 95.4, and this is
consistent with a diverse study pool spanning different exercise modalities.

The pooled estimate is consistent with the abstract-level evidence base and
suggests a directionally informative signal rather than a definitive effect.
